banner.title: Importance of local sustainability
banner.text: Sustainability ensures that our needs are met for all future generations and its important for everyone to promote sustainable practices to help our communities. Learn how our community can contribute to global sustainability efforts through local actions.

text.title: Welcome to the Sustainability Advisory Committee
text.text: The Sustainability Advisory Committee (SAC) is focused on promoting sustainable practices within the local community. We seek to raise awareness about environmental issues and encourage individuals and organizations to take action towards a more sustainable future.
